subject: a deer with doorway-like antlers
art_direction: 奶白小鹿的短角围成开放小门，门后只有一块柔杏色光面。
visible_description: 奶白小鹿的短角围成开放小门，门后只有一块柔杏色光面。
composition: Square 1024x1024 avatar. The distinct subject, face, object or abstract form occupies about 65–80% of the canvas, and remains readable at small size. Important features sit safely near the center with room for a circular crop, but DO NOT draw a circular frame, badge, disc backdrop or circular mask. Render a complete square background. Vary silhouette, expression, angle, asymmetry, and density as the individual direction requests. Appealing eyes and a purposeful expression matter when a face is present; never force a face onto a faceless concept.
creative_direction: Sculpt a cream deer bust with two short antlers forming an open doorway above its head. A single soft apricot plane behind the opening suggests warm light without a literal room. Bow the face slightly with welcoming calm and small steady eyes. Use matte painted surfaces, careful edge light and a muted blue-green background, keeping the form uncluttered. Square 1024x1024, centered with a distinct silhouette and generous circular-crop clearance, without a circular frame. Original peaceful design, no text, branding, or watermark.
visual_review: passed: compressed preview inspected for appealing subject, coherent anatomy and structures, distinct medium, intentional color and composition, clean text-free artwork
